metadata.description: Official Telnyx plugin marketplace for AI coding agents — the telnyx-developer-kit starter plus modular plugins for WhatsApp, Voice, SMS, Email, TTS, STT, Verify, AI, Numbers, WebRTC, and platform services

plugins.name: telnyx-developer-kit
plugins.description: The one-install starter kit: six focused build skills, the telnyx-builder agent, and an OAuth-authenticated hosted MCP connector with a reviewed five-tool contract for Call Control and recordings. Add product plugins for other API coverage.

plugins.name: telnyx-whatsapp
plugins.description: Telnyx WhatsApp Business API — send messages, manage templates, WABAs, and phone numbers

plugins.name: telnyx-voice
plugins.description: Telnyx Voice API — call control, DTMF, recording, noise suppression, AMD, deepfake detection, number masking, SIPREC, streaming

plugins.name: telnyx-messaging
plugins.description: Telnyx SMS/MMS — send, schedule, group MMS, delivery webhooks, opt-out handling, messaging profiles

plugins.name: telnyx-email
plugins.description: Telnyx Email — send transactional email, manage inboxes, configure sending domains, suppressions, and unsubscribe groups

plugins.name: telnyx-tts
plugins.description: Telnyx Text-to-Speech — generate speech from text via Telnyx and third-party providers (AWS, Azure, ElevenLabs, MiniMax, Resemble, Rime, xAI)

plugins.name: telnyx-stt
plugins.description: Telnyx Speech-to-Text — transcribe audio to text via OpenAI-compatible endpoint with model, language, and keyword biasing

plugins.name: telnyx-verify
plugins.description: Telnyx Verify — phone verification via SMS, call, or flash call (2FA OTP)

plugins.name: telnyx-ai
plugins.description: Telnyx AI — LLM inference, chat completions, embeddings, AI assistants, Meeting Bot, conversation insights

plugins.name: telnyx-numbers
plugins.description: Telnyx Numbers — search, buy, manage phone numbers, 10DLC compliance registration, number porting

plugins.name: telnyx-webrtc
plugins.description: Telnyx WebRTC — browser-based real-time communications, video rooms, WebRTC client SDKs

plugins.name: telnyx-platform
plugins.description: Telnyx Platform — account management, fax, IoT, networking, SIP, storage, TeXML, OAuth, Twilio migration, and other platform services
